g.text: Ring 0 · cross-section through the Grand Market (Quarter 1, s = 400 m)
Cut between two frame nodes, looking along the ring. Levels above ring 0's floor, 3,063 m above the summit.
Summit port · ring 0 · design proposal (artistic), structure informed by the tower study's hand sizing · 28 September 2026
